info.title: Composio Webhook Events
info.description: Payloads Composio sends to your webhook endpoints. Webhook events go to the URL on your webhook subscription. Session webhooks go to your session webhook URL, and Composio waits for your answer. For signature verification, see the Verifying webhooks guide.

tags.name: Webhook Events
tags.description: Events delivered by Composio to your registered webhook endpoints

tags.name: Session Webhooks
tags.description: Requests Composio sends to your session webhook URL during a tool call, and the answer it waits for

type.description: A proxy call: an HTTP request to the toolkit API. The call is in `http_request`.

toolkit_slug.description: Slug of the toolkit whose API is called (for example github).

connected_account_id.description: ID of the connected account the call uses. Omitted when the call doesn't use one, for example a toolkit that needs no auth.

endpoint.description: The endpoint as the agent gave it: a path relative to the toolkit's API base URL, or a full URL.

type.description: Whether the parameter is a header or a query parameter.

url.description: URL to fetch binary content from

Content-Type header to use for the request

binary_body.description: The file the request uploads, as the agent sent it: `{ url, content_type }`, a URL Composio downloads the file from, or `{ base64, content_type }`, the file itself. Omitted when the request uploads no file.

data.description: The call about to run. `type` says whether it is a tool call or a proxy call.

arguments.subject: Pricing
arguments.body: Our floor price is $40 per seat.

200.description: Answer with HTTP 200 and a JSON body that says what to do with the call. Any other status, a body that doesn't match (a misspelled field included), or no answer within the hook's `timeout_ms` counts as a failure: Composio doesn't retry, and the hook's `fallback_action` applies. Fields you don't use can be left out or sent as null.

message.description: Not used when the call goes ahead.

arguments.description: Arguments to call the tool with, in place of the original ones.

http_request.description: Not used here. Leave it out, or send null.

type.description: Whether the parameter is a header or a query parameter.

url.description: URL to fetch binary content from

content_type.description: Content-Type header to use for the request
Content-Type header to use for the request

binary_body.description: File to upload in place of the original body or file, in the same shape as the request.

http_request.description: Fields of the request to replace. Fields left out keep their original value. `body` and `binary_body` each replace whichever of the two the call had; set at most one. The toolkit cannot be changed.

tool_call.description: Not used here. Leave it out, or send null.

override.description: Run the call with these changes. Use `tool_call` for a tool call and `http_request` for a proxy call; the other one counts as an answer that does not match.

message.description: Why the call was stopped. Shown to the agent.

post.description: Sent after a tool or proxy call runs, when the session has an `after_execute` hook with a `webhook` handler. Composio waits for your answer before the agent sees the result, and can withhold it or pass on your changes.

action.description: Pass the response on to the agent.

message.description: Not used when the response is passed on.

data.description: Data to give the agent, in place of the tool's data.

http_response.description: Not used here. Leave it out, or send null.

data.description: Response body to give the agent, in place of the API's response body.

headers.description: Headers to give the agent, in place of the API's headers. Replaces them in full.

http_response.description: Fields of the response to replace. Fields left out keep their original value. The status and a binary file cannot be changed.

tool_response.description: Not used here. Leave it out, or send null.

override.description: Give the agent this in place of what the call returned. Use `tool_response` for a tool call and `http_response` for a proxy call; the other one counts as an answer that does not match.

message.description: Why the call was stopped. Shown to the agent.

data.body: My card is [REDACTED], please update billing.
